description: Re-check one page and commit: pass resolves the finding; else records the verdict and leaves it open. Use findingStateId or proposalId (exactly one); proposal verification needs a target URL and expect. Optional expect (≤5 fields: title, meta_description, canonical, h1, meta_robots) is read from the same live fetch; a mismatch keeps the finding open and does not complete the task. Not a ranking result. Research is context. Requires audits:write; confirm + unique idempotencyKey; previews without confirm.
name: verify_fix
title: Verify a fix and close the finding
